items.question: What hand-span measurements are prescribed as the smallest and alternative sizes?
premises: The term kaniṣṭhaṃ designates the smallest prescribed measurement.
The compound daśa+hastam specifies a length of ten hand-spans.
The compound ṣoḍaśa+hastakam specifies a length of sixteen hand-spans as a parallel option.
items.inference: The smallest prescribed size is ten hand-spans, with sixteen hand-spans given as a corresponding alternative.
uncertainties: Whether ṣoḍaśa+hastakam is presented as another smallest option or as a distinct alternative grade is not fully explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: The smallest measure is ten hand-spans, and likewise sixteen hand-spans.
